# Vendored subset of Intel DL Streamer v2026.2.0 (MIT, see LICENSE) with the
# local patches from patches/ already applied. Element names stay `gva*` so that
# DL Streamer pipelines keep working. See third_party/dlstreamer/README.AMD.md.
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(GVA_GST REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET gstreamer-1.0>=1.28.2 gstreamer-base-1.0 gstreamer-video-1.0 gstreamer-analytics-1.0 gstreamer-allocators-1.0 gstreamer-rtp-1.0 gstreamer-va-1.0)
find_path(GVA_OPENCV_INCLUDE opencv2/core.hpp HINTS "${AMDVA_SYSROOT}/usr/include" PATH_SUFFIXES opencv4 REQUIRED)
find_library(GVA_OPENCV_CORE opencv_core HINTS "${AMDVA_SYSROOT}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu" REQUIRED)
find_library(GVA_OPENCV_IMGPROC opencv_imgproc HINTS "${AMDVA_SYSROOT}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu" REQUIRED)
find_library(GVA_UUID NAMES uuid libuuid.so.1 REQUIRED)
if(AMDVA_WITH_KAFKA)
  find_library(GVA_KAFKA_CPP rdkafka++ HINTS "${AMDVA_SYSROOT}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu" REQUIRED)
  find_path(GVA_KAFKA_INCLUDE librdkafka/rdkafkacpp.h HINTS "${AMDVA_SYSROOT}/usr/include" REQUIRED)
endif()
if(AMDVA_WITH_MQTT)
  find_library(GVA_PAHO paho-mqtt3as HINTS "${AMDVA_SYSROOT}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu" REQUIRED)
endif()

set(DLS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set(mono "${DLS}/src/monolithic")
set(track "${mono}/gst/elements/gvatrack")
set(convert "${mono}/gst/elements/gvametaconvert")
set(publish "${mono}/gst/elements/gvametapublish")
set(GVA_GEN "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${GVA_GEN}")
file(WRITE "${GVA_GEN}/config.h" "#pragma once\n#define ENABLE_VAAPI\n#define PLUGIN_VERSION \"2026.2.0-amd\"\n#define PLUGIN_LICENSE \"MIT/X11\"\n#define PACKAGE \"dlstreamer\"\n#define PACKAGE_NAME \"DL Streamer elements (AMD vendored subset)\"\n#define PRODUCT_FULL_NAME \"DL Streamer\"\n#define GST_PACKAGE_ORIGIN \"https://github.com/open-edge-platform/dlstreamer\"\n")
file(WRITE "${GVA_GEN}/gvametapublish_export.h" "#pragma once\n#define GVAMETAPUBLISH_EXPORTS\n")

file(GLOB_RECURSE tracker_sources "${track}/*.cpp" "${track}/*.c")
file(GLOB convert_sources "${convert}/*.cpp" "${convert}/*.c")
file(GLOB meta_sources "${DLS}/src/gst/metadata/*.c")
file(GLOB utils_sources "${DLS}/src/utils/*.cpp")
add_library(amdva_gva_common SHARED ${meta_sources} ${utils_sources}
  "${mono}/gst/common/gva_caps.c" "${mono}/gst/common/gva_utils.cpp" "${mono}/gst/common/logger_functions.cpp"
  "${mono}/inference_backend/logger/logger.cpp" "${mono}/inference_backend/logger/perf_logger.cpp")
set(extra_sources)
set(extra_includes)
foreach(element gvastreammux gvastreamdemux gvametaaggregate)
  file(GLOB element_sources "${mono}/gst/elements/${element}/*.cpp" "${mono}/gst/elements/${element}/*.c")
  list(FILTER element_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "/register_[^/]+\\.c$")
  list(APPEND extra_sources ${element_sources})
  list(APPEND extra_includes "${mono}/gst/elements/${element}")
endforeach()
add_library(gstgva MODULE register.cpp ${tracker_sources} ${convert_sources} ${extra_sources})
target_include_directories(gstgva PRIVATE ${extra_includes})
file(GLOB publish_sources "${publish}/*.cpp" "${publish}/base/*.cpp" "${publish}/file/*.cpp")
add_library(gstgvametapublish SHARED ${publish_sources})
# Broker modules are optional; gvametapublish loads them by name at run time.
set(publish_modules)
if(AMDVA_WITH_MQTT)
  file(GLOB mqtt_sources "${publish}/mqtt/*.cpp")
  add_library(gstgvametapublishmqtt MODULE ${mqtt_sources})
  target_link_libraries(gstgvametapublishmqtt PRIVATE gstgvametapublish ${GVA_PAHO} ${GVA_UUID})
  list(APPEND publish_modules gstgvametapublishmqtt)
endif()
if(AMDVA_WITH_KAFKA)
  file(GLOB kafka_sources "${publish}/kafka/*.cpp")
  add_library(gstgvametapublishkafka MODULE ${kafka_sources})
  target_link_libraries(gstgvametapublishkafka PRIVATE gstgvametapublish ${GVA_KAFKA_CPP})
  target_include_directories(gstgvametapublishkafka PRIVATE "${GVA_KAFKA_INCLUDE}" "${GVA_KAFKA_INCLUDE}/librdkafka")
  list(APPEND publish_modules gstgvametapublishkafka)
endif()
if(publish_modules)
  set_target_properties(${publish_modules} PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN")
endif()

set(gva_targets amdva_gva_common gstgva gstgvametapublish ${publish_modules})
foreach(target ${gva_targets})
  target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE
    "${GVA_GEN}" "${DLS}/include" "${DLS}/include/dlstreamer/gst/metadata"
    "${DLS}/include/dlstreamer/gst/videoanalytics" "${DLS}/src/utils" "${mono}/gst/common"
    "${mono}/inference_backend/include" "${track}" "${convert}" "${publish}" "${publish}/base"
    "${GVA_OPENCV_INCLUDE}")
  target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE PkgConfig::GVA_GST PkgConfig::VA "${GVA_OPENCV_CORE}" "${GVA_OPENCV_IMGPROC}" ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
  target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE GST_USE_UNSTABLE_API)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -include "${GVA_GEN}/config.h" -w)
  target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wl,--no-undefined)
endforeach()
foreach(target gstgva gstgvametapublish ${publish_modules})
  target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE amdva_gva_common)
endforeach()
set_target_properties(gstgva gstgvametapublish ${publish_modules} PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugins")
install(TARGETS amdva_gva_common LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(TARGETS gstgva gstgvametapublish ${publish_modules} LIBRARY DESTINATION lib/gstreamer-1.0)
install(DIRECTORY "${DLS}/include/dlstreamer/gst/metadata" DESTINATION include/dlstreamer/gst)
install(FILES LICENSE third-party-programs.txt DESTINATION share/doc/amdva/dlstreamer)
